home.title: Welcome to Averroes
home.subtitle: A focused workspace for talking to your AI, using tools and skills, and keeping every project in context.
home.step_intro_description: Averroes keeps conversations, project context, tools and skills together in one place.
home.step_connection_description: Add a provider or sign in to an account. You will choose its model when you start working.
home.step_workspace_description: Open a folder to give conversations a project and a safe working context.
home.step_conversation_description: Ask for a plan, a change or an investigation. The conversation stays attached to its workspace.
home.no_workspaces: No workspaces yet. Open a folder to get started.

settings.title: Settings
settings.connections_description: Add multiple accounts, including several from the same provider. New work restores the active connection, model, and tools; every conversation can still change them.
settings.no_connections: No connections yet. Use the form to add one.
settings.credentials_description: Credentials are entered here and are never read from the environment.
settings.name: Name
settings.models_description: Connect providers, refresh their catalogs, or add a model manually when an integration does not expose one.
settings.agents_description: Define delegated agents with a clear purpose and an explicit provider model.
settings.delegated_agents_description: Delegated agents · purpose and model are explicit
settings.remote_agent_description: Bring a live Averroes conversation to Telegram, with explicit access control and the same agent context.
settings.remote_agent_hero_description: Telegram becomes a secure window into the same conversation running on this Mac.
settings.remote_agent_ready: Relay configured · Telegram credentials are saved
settings.remote_agent_not_configured: Connect a Telegram bot to get started
settings.remote_agent_live_description: Stream progress and replies into one Telegram chat.
settings.remote_agent_screenshots_descri: Send the current desktop or browser view when you need eyes on the work.
settings.remote_agent_approval_descripti: Answer agent questions and approve sensitive actions from your phone.
settings.remote_agent_security_descripti: Only accounts approved from this settings page can use the relay.
settings.remote_agent_flow_description: The relay does not create a second agent. It attaches Telegram to the selected conversation, so desktop and mobile share the same history, tools, and screenshots.
settings.remote_agent_preview_message: Build finished. Want me to send a screenshot?
settings.remote_agent_connect_descriptio: Create a bot with BotFather, then paste its token here. The token is encrypted locally and never written to settings.toml.
settings.remote_agent_pairing_descriptio: Open the bot and send /start. Approve the request here—no Telegram ID needs to be copied.
settings.remote_agent_pairing_empty: No pending requests. New users appear here after they message the bot.
settings.remote_agent_allowed_users_help: No accounts have been approved yet.
settings.no_agents_description: Create an agent to give recurring delegated work a dedicated model and purpose.
settings.agent_description_help: The purpose helps the parent agent choose the right specialist.
settings.memory_description: Choose a connected provider to compile local conversation fragments. The index is stored in SQLite and contains no credentials.
settings.not_configured: Not configured · text search is still available
settings.no_providers_description: Use Add provider to connect an account or local integration.
settings.credentials_direct: Credentials are entered directly and saved securely in macOS Keychain.
settings.codex_description: Codex connects directly with your ChatGPT plan. No CLI is used.
settings.codex_full_description: Averroes connects directly to Codex using your ChatGPT plan—no Codex CLI is installed or launched. OAuth is encrypted on disk with a random key stored in macOS Keychain.
settings.copilot_description: Use GitHub sign-in or paste a token manually.
settings.copilot_full_description: Sign in directly with GitHub to use your Copilot plan. No API key is required and Averroes never reads GitHub CLI or environment credentials.
settings.ollama_description: Ollama uses a local HTTP server and does not need an API key.
settings.ollama_local_description: No API key is needed for local Ollama. Leave the URL blank to use http://localhost:11434.
settings.ollama_cloud_description: Ollama Cloud uses an API key and the OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Leave the URL blank to use https://ollama.com/v1.
settings.qdivzero_description: QDivZero uses an API key, its OpenAI-compatible chat and embeddings endpoints, and a live catalog of running serving endpoints.
settings.reasoning_help: Optional, for example: low, medium, high. The model is stored in this integration's catalog.
settings.session_trace: Session-only request trace. Credentials and recognizable token values are redacted.
settings.local_by_design: Local by design. Credentials never come from the environment.
settings.storage_description: A random encryption key lives in macOS Keychain. Credentials are encrypted in providers.enc; projects, conversations, and checkpoints live in averroes.db without keys or tokens.
settings.language_description: Choose the language used by the Averroes interface.
settings.provider_catalogs: Provider catalogs · live and manual models
settings.local_storage: Local encrypted storage · no environment secrets
settings.about_description: A small, local-first agent workspace from Valendra.tech

about.title: About
about.philosopher: Ibn Rushd (Averroes), born in Córdoba in al-Andalus, was an Andalusian philosopher, physician, and jurist. His influential commentaries on Aristotle helped carry classical Greek thought into medieval Europe and shaped European philosophy, theology, and science.
